description: This file defines the ClientAddressRepository interface in a Java project using Spring Data JPA. The interface extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide data access methods for ClientAddress entities, including custom query methods for retrieving client address information based on client ID, address type, activity status, and address ID.

classes.description: Repository interface for ClientAddress entity, providing database query methods
